reviews.text: Very good school with excellent professionals.
I'm so happy with the results after just a few months of training! Highly recommend
Great place!! My puppy and I take classes here and we love it.

This dog school offers an excellent training approach based on positive reinforcement. What stands out is their focus on teaching owners how to train their dogs effectively. Throughout each class, they provide hands-on support, guiding owners step-by-step to ensure they understand the techniques and can confidently apply them at home as well. The methodology creates a positive learning environment for both the dogs and their owners, emphasizing patience, consistency, and mutual respect. It's a great program for anyone looking to strengthen the bond with their dog while using effective, humane training methods. Highly recommend this approach to dog training!

The best decision I ever made was coming to CIC! I always had difficulty walking Ozzy, either because he pulled or because he wasn't tolerant of other dogs. Week after week, training after training, and along with the tools I received for training at home/on the street, the walks became everything I needed: calm and tolerant. I have nothing but good things to say about CIC, and the word "school" has become one of Ozzy's favorites. A special thank you to Cristiana for her flexibility and patience from the beginning :)
